"milkV" is silkscreened on board top and "DUO_MB_V1.2" on board bottom. {{See also|Milk-V|List of SBCs}}
Available Duo USB & Ethernet IoB exposes 4x USB 2.0 ports :and 1x 100M Ethernet in a ''Raspberry Pi B'' format.
===Links=== *[https://linuxgizmos.com/milk-v-duo-is-a-9-00-risc-v-tiny-embedded-computer/ ''Milk-V Duo RISC-V Tiny Embedded Computer'' on '''LinuxGizmos'''] *[https://www.hackster.io/news/milk-v-unveils-its-third-risc-v-board-in-a-month-the-9-dual-core-linux-capable-milk-v-duo-3fb5d9f978d1 ''Milk-V Unveils Dual-Core Linux-Capable Milk-V Duo'' on '''hackster.io''']
===Hardware specification=== *CPU: [[CVitek]] CV1800B @1.0GHz :SoC: 64-bit RISC-V C906 @700MHz :MCU 8051 @300MHz,NPU: 0.2 TOPS *Storage: TF card (max.128GB)/MMC card slot *Memory: 64MB (DDR2) RAM (integrated SiP) *Network: 1x Fast Ethernet port (via 5x I/O pins) *USB: 1x USB 2.0 (Type-C) port *GPIO: 2x 20-pin headers *Power Source: 5V via USB (Type-C) port
